mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, real_name, status FROM sys_admin_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_admin_user u ON ur.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username}

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code, p.permission_name, p.permission_type, p.menu_key FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_admin_user u ON ur.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY p.permission_code ASC

SELECT p.permission_id, p.permission_name, p.permission_code, p.permission_type, p.menu_key, p.parent_code, p.description, p.sort, p.status FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON rp.role_id = r.role_id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY p.sort ASC, p.permission_id ASC
SELECT permission_id, permission_name, permission_code, permission_type, menu_key, parent_code, description, sort, status FROM sys_permission ORDER BY sort ASC, permission_id ASC
SELECT role_id, role_name, role_code, description, status FROM sys_role ORDER BY role_id ASC
SELECT p.permission_code FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.sort ASC
SELECT role_id FROM sys_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId} LIMIT 1
SELECT permission_id FROM sys_permission WHERE permission_code = #{permissionCode} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_role_permission(role_id, permission_id, create_time) VALUES(#{roleId}, #{permissionId}, now())

INSERT INTO sys_role(role_id, role_name, role_code, description, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{roleId}, #{roleName}, #{roleCode}, #{description}, #{status}, now(), now()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role_name = VALUES(role_name), role_code = VALUES(role_code), description = VALUES(description), status = VALUES(status), update_time = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET status = #{status}, update_time = now() WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_permission( permission_id, permission_name, permission_code, permission_type, menu_key, parent_code, description, sort, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES( #{permissionId}, #{permissionName}, #{permissionCode}, #{permissionType}, #{menuKey}, #{parentCode}, #{description}, #{sort}, #{status}, now(), now() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE permission_name = VALUES(permission_name), permission_code = VALUES(permission_code), permission_type = VALUES(permission_type), menu_key = VALUES(menu_key), parent_code = VALUES(parent_code), description = VALUES(description), sort = VALUES(sort), status = VALUES(status), update_time = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_permission SET status = #{status}, update_time = now() WHERE permission_id = #{permissionId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_admin_user u ON ur.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.permission_code = #{permissionCode}
